description: Animate a forward pass through a wider network [5, 8, 5] with larger layer spacing to make edge flows visually clear.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_ml.neural_network import NeuralNetwork, FeedForwardLayer

class FFNForwardPassSpaced(ThreeDScene):
    def construct(self):
        nn = NeuralNetwork([
            FeedForwardLayer(5),
            FeedForwardLayer(8),
            FeedForwardLayer(5),
        ], layer_spacing=0.4)
        nn.scale(0.85)
        nn.move_to(ORIGIN)
        self.add(nn)
        self.play(nn.make_forward_pass_animation())
        self.wait(0.5)
